Class SecurityPositionReplay

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reports.SecurityPositionReplay
@Component public class SecurityPositionReplay extends Object
Walks the security transactions of a set of security accounts through the position calculation. The same security in different security accounts is merged into one SecurityPositionSummary, keyed by the security.

Shared by the security account reports, which value the resulting positions afterwards, and by the period performance per security, which only reads the flow each transaction causes. Each account is walked in SecurityCalcService.sortForCalculation(List) order; transactions without a security, for example fees, are skipped. The walk runs on the calling thread, because the summaries and the lazily loaded transactions are not safe on another one.

    • replay

      public void replay(List<Securityaccount> securityaccounts, Map<Security, SecurityPositionSummary> summarySecurityMap, boolean excludeDivTaxcost, DateTransactionCurrencypairMap dateCurrencyMap, CostBasisMethods costBasisMethods, Predicate<Transaction> include, BiConsumer<Transaction, Map<Integer, List<Securitysplit>>> splitObserver, BiConsumer<Transaction, SecurityPositionSummary> positionObserver)
      Processes the selected transactions of the given security accounts.
      Parameters:
      securityaccounts - the accounts whose transactions are walked
      summarySecurityMap - receives one summary per security; may already hold summaries to continue
      excludeDivTaxcost - if true, tax withholdings of income are not deducted
      dateCurrencyMap - currency context supplying the rate of each transaction
      costBasisMethods - the cost basis methods of the report
      include - selects the transactions to process. Because every account is walked in ascending time, a predicate on the transaction time behaves like stopping at the first excluded transaction.
      splitObserver - called after each processed transaction with the split map of its account, may be null
      positionObserver - called after each processed transaction with the summary of its security, may be null

    • replayAccount

      public void replayAccount(Integer idSecuritycashAccount, List<Transaction> transactions, Map<Security, SecurityPositionSummary> summarySecurityMap, boolean excludeDivTaxcost, DateTransactionCurrencypairMap dateCurrencyMap, CostBasisMethods costBasisMethods, BiConsumer<Transaction, SecurityPositionSummary> positionObserver)
      Processes the given transactions of one security account, for a caller that loaded only the transactions it needs, for example those of one security, instead of the account's whole transaction list.
      Parameters:
      idSecuritycashAccount - the security account the transactions belong to; its splits are loaded
      transactions - transactions of that account, in any order
      summarySecurityMap - receives one summary per security; may already hold summaries to continue
      excludeDivTaxcost - if true, tax withholdings of income are not deducted
      dateCurrencyMap - currency context supplying the rate of each transaction
      costBasisMethods - the cost basis methods of the report
      positionObserver - called after each processed transaction with the summary of its security, may be null
